Proper termination of incoming and outgoing cables, internal wiring modifications, interconnections, crimping, tightening, insulation and circuit identification. e. Ensure proper coordination of protective devices with the connected electrical loads and upstream protection systems. f. All distribution boards shall be properly labelled with circuit identification, ratings, source details and updated circuit sche dules. 2.3 Industrial Power Outlets and Equipment Connections a. Supply and installation of industrial-grade single-phase and three-phase metal-clad socket outlets, including associated M CB protection, enclosures, interlocking arrangements wherever specified and necessary electrical accessories. b. Installation of 200A, four-pole switch disconnector/isolator for designated SFC/Compressor feeder applications. d. All industrial socket outlets and isolators shall be installed at the designated locations, ensuring proper mounting, electri cal connectivity, mechanical protection and safe operation. 2.4 Air-Conditioning Installation a. r piping, insulation, condensate drainage, electrical interconnections, necessary supports and accessories. c. Earth continuity and other applicable electrical tests shall be conducted before commissioning. 2.8 Power Distribution Cables and Interconnections a.
